description:
Reverse Engineered Private Arsenal

Reverse Engineered Private Arsenal adds a colony industry chain that takes apart the weapons, fighters and ships you deposit, learns to reproduce them, and sells you copies from an integrated Private Arsenal submarket. Vanilla and modded gear alike.
The code is fully open source. You don't have to credit me. Claude Code built this anyway.
Requires LunaLib.

Screenshots

The Reverse Engineering Hub
A player only structure you build on your own colony. It comes in three tiers that you upgrade like any other industry.
Unraidable and it cannot be disrupted.
The tier decides what you are allowed to reverse engineer:
Tier 1: weapons only.
Tier 2: weapons and fighter wings.
Tier 3: weapons, fighter wings and ships.

The hub owns two submarkets: the Reverse Engineering Storage where you deposit items, and the Private Arsenal where you buy the results.

Reverse Engineering Storage
Drop weapons, fighter LPCs and ships here to queue them for analysis.
Every day the hub pulls one item out of storage and works on it. It picks items you have not unlocked yet first, then falls back to anything else in storage.
It refuses anything already reverse engineered here, since that is already stocked in the Arsenal, and it refuses item types your current tier cannot handle.

The Private Arsenal
A player submarket that stocks every weapon, fighter wing and ship your hub has reverse engineered, fifty respawning copies of each.
What appears follows the hub tier: weapons at Tier 1, fighters added at Tier 2, ships added at Tier 3 but include a hefty markup.
You can only buy here. Selling is not allowed.
It is not part of the global economy, so it does not feed or distort markets.

AI Cores Drive Everything
The AI core you assign to the hub sets both the research speed per item and the Private Arsenal price. Default values, all tunable in LunaLib:
No core: 30 days per item, Arsenal price 2.0 times base value.
Gamma: 20 days, 1.6 times.
Beta: 15 days, 1.0 times.
Alpha: 5 days, 0.4 times.
Omega: 2 days, free.

A better core means faster research and cheaper copies. An Omega core (Astral Ascension optional crossover) makes the whole Arsenal free.

Drone Replicator and Improvement
You can install a Combat Drone Replicator colony item into the hub. It normally only goes on ground defenses and heavy batteries, but here it shaves a flat number of days off every item's research time. (Configurable)
Improving the hub with a story point makes each reverse engineered item also drop its real blueprint into storage. The copy count is configurable. An un improved hub only stocks the Arsenal and never produces a physical blueprint.

Settings
Everything is exposed through LunaLib: research days for each core, the Drone Replicator day reduction, blueprint copies per improved item, the Arsenal price multiplier for each core, and a debug logging toggle.

FAQ
What do I need to run it?
LunaLib. That is the only dependency.
Where and when do I build the hub?
On one of your own colonies. There is no prerequisite, only money. Unlocked at the start. It is a player only structure, three tiers, upgraded like any industry.
Does it work with modded weapons, fighters and ships?
Yes. It reverse engineers whatever you deposit, vanilla or modded.Compatibility patches were made to avoid crashes on non-compliant weapons/wings
Can I add or remove it mid save?
Adding to an existing save is fine. Removing it mid save is not recommended, as with any mod that adds industries and submarkets.
Version log
v1.1.1: Fixed a save-corruption crash where the Private Arsenal's stocked ships were stored with an invalid faction, throwing an error during save (worst after demolishing the hub, which left the submarket lingering in colony memory). The arsenal now always uses a valid faction, and demolishing the hub fully removes its submarkets.
v1.1.0: The Reverse Engineering Hub now researches several items of each type in parallel instead of one at a time, scaling with hub tier and item size (defaults give 6 weapons, 3 fighters, and 2 ships at tier 3). Slot counts and per-type sizes are configurable in LunaLib, and per-item notifications are now batched into one message per type.
v1.0.0
Initial public release. Reverse Engineering Hub structure in three tiers, with tier gated weapons, fighters and ships. Reverse Engineering Storage for depositing items and a Private Arsenal submarket that stocks fifty copies of everything you have reverse engineered. AI core driven research speed and Arsenal pricing, Combat Drone Replicator support, story point improvement that also produces real blueprints, and full LunaLib configuration.

discordPostHtml:
Ever wanted to copy that rare weapon or ship you found instead of hoping for a blueprint drop? Build a Reverse Engineering Hub on your colony. Deposit weapons, fighters, or ships into storage. Each day the hub researches one item. Once done, you get fifty copies to buy from an integrated Private Arsenal submarket at a configurable price.
The hub comes in three tiers. Tier 1 handles weapons, Tier 2 adds fighters, Tier 3 adds ships (but you only get their blueprints when improved). Assign an AI core for bonuses: it speeds up research AND cuts the Arsenal prices.
Requires LunaLib. Works with modded gear. Full source on GitHub. No credits needed.
Download: https://github.com/andrzejsokolowski/starsector-private-arsenal/releases/latest
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35627.0

This mod is a complete rewrite of DarkQOL's private arsenal/reverse engineering industries. I opted to coalesce them into one thing.
DarkQOL's abandoned and buggy, so I fixed it up, changed the logic and balance, and gave it a small general feel update.
Most of the mod is configurable via lunaSettings.
